python3 - <<'EOF'
from collections import defaultdict
from code2llm.core.config import Config
from code2llm.core.file_analyzer import FileAnalyzer
res = FileAnalyzer(Config()).analyze_file('src/koru/autonomy/cycle/cycle_config.py', 'koru.autonomy.cycle.cycle_config')
by_scope = defaultdict(list)
for m in res['mutations']:
    by_scope[getattr(m, 'scope', None)].append(m)
for name, fi in res['functions'].items():
    cc = fi.complexity.get('cyclomatic_complexity', 1)
    fan = len(set(fi.calls))
    mc = len(by_scope.get(name, []))
    assert not (fan > 10 or mc > 6 or cc > 12), (name, cc, fan, mc)
EOF
